acs.text_first_line: AC1 A routed pack moves the case to WITH_COMMITTEE and books the meeting
AC2 A case with an open deviation is held out of the population
AC3 The committee, the meeting and the write-off stay the write-off service's
AC4 A repeated routing answer changes nothing
AC5 No rule version in force refuses the routing answer
AC6 A routing that cannot be recorded does not move the case
AC7 The case read is refused without the right or outside the scope
AC8 SCR-27 shows the write-off state, the committee queue and the meeting date
